rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Nanticoke Health Services and Peninsula Regional Health System signed letter of intent to merge January 2019.
Delaware Health Resources Board and FTC approved Nanticoke-Peninsula Regional merger October 2019; definitive agreement signed July 2019.

fitch._warning: Merger closed January 1 2020 (just outside window). At 2019-12-31 snapshot, Nanticoke standalone bonds technically outstanding pending merger close. Fitch rating assumed unchanged BBB- absent contrary action. Effectively a TERMINATED_BY_MERGER outcome 2 days after window close.

outcome_class_rationale: Nanticoke maintained Fitch BBB-/Stable through 2017-2019 window. Merger with Peninsula Regional announced Jan 2019, approved Oct 2019, but did not formally close until Jan 1 2020. Within window: stable rating but with material structural change pending. Note: user prompt suggested 2017 close — that is incorrect; actual close was 2020-01-01.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Industry-typical estimates for small Delaware standalone community hospital at BBB-. Two-year earnings ~$7M reported (2017-mid 2018) per Delaware Business Now.

_research_notes: User prompt timeline incorrect: merger LOI was Jan 2019, definitive agreement July 2019, regulatory approval Oct 2019, close Jan 1 2020. Within 2017-2018 there were no formal M&A events — though management was exploring options since ~2014. Driver of eventual merger: CMS designated all 3 DE counties as urban, costing Nanticoke ~$6M/yr in add-on payments over 3 years.
